case_zone_summary.note: The same province-to-zone proxy weights are applied to the 100/119/150 Mm3 curve. The 119 Mm3 zone totals reproduce handoff v9.

caveats: All values are model estimates; observed=false and policy_grade=false.
Every multi-zone province allocation is a proxy share; no observed sub-provincial residue split exists.
BC uses OSeCAN zonal supply dispatch; AB, ON, and QC use OSeCAN zonal energy dispatch as an activity proxy.
Process and harvest residue are separate streams and are never summed.
Process rows use the TOTAL class row only; harvest rows use the ALL row only.
SUPBCW technology strings are candidate mappings, not operating assignments.
The 2050 OSeCAN and supply-curve values are context, not policy targets.
No official OSeCAN file or public OSeCAN surface is changed.
No transport, cost, tenure, AAC, or policy claim is made.
Branch and foliage add dry mass but no measured volume. The handoff PJ totals therefore rise without changing mill products or process residue.
0.35/0.60/0.75 recovery cases are carried; 0.60 is a reference case, not a calibrated recovery factor.
E2 product shares replace donor product coefficients for nine provinces; E2 branch/foliage add dry mass but no measured volume.
0.35/0.60/0.75 recovery cases are carried; 0.60 is a reference case, not a calibrated recovery factor.
E2c density calibration changes stems/ha expansion, not per-m3 product or residue coefficients. The v8 curve totals differ from v7 through the E2 v1 to E2c coefficient change only.
0.35/0.60/0.75 recovery cases are carried; 0.60 is a reference case, not a calibrated recovery factor.
Assignment v10 changes the facility province of some process residue; national process PJ and the OSeCAN tiers are unchanged.
Transport cost is not part of the OSeCAN handoff or its official supply-curve tiers.
The 100/150 Mm3 case zone totals use the same province-to-zone weights as 119 Mm3; they are not observed sub-provincial shares.
